**0.6.3: the version at the bottom of the window, and screenshots in your software centre.**

- **The version is always visible** at the bottom right of the window (*Hebrish 0.6.3*). Click it to see what changed.
- **Ubuntu: Discover and GNOME Software now show Hebrish properly**, with a description, screenshots and links, once it's installed.
- Releases are now tagged and checked automatically, so the version in the app always matches the release.
- Models, settings and downloads are unchanged. Updates arrive through apt, or through *Update now* in the app if you have 0.6.2.
- Ubuntu 26.04 .deb and a portable Windows zip. Not yet tested on Windows hardware. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
